articles.title: Digital Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 Games Are on Sale for Black Friday
articles.summary: We’ve almost made it to Black Friday. The official retail holiday lands on November 27 this year, but metric tons of deals are already available as we speak. That includes digital games for Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch.
body: What games are on sale? For Nintendo Switch 2, you can save a little on very recent releases, including the phenomenal The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. It’s only $5 off, but it just came out. I beat it the other day, and I have to say I found playing it to be close to a religious experience. It’s that good. It’s the best-looking game Nintendo has ever released, and the 1998-era puzzle design holds up impossibly well. I loved every second of that game, and I look forward to replaying it in a year or so.

Other Switch 2 digital games on sale include the incredibly fun and destructive Donkey Kong Bananza. The open-world Mario Kart World is on sale, in case you didn’t get it bundled with your Switch 2. And a handful of other worthy releases are also on sale.

On the OG Nintendo Switch side of things, you have a number of games to choose from. My top recommendation would be Metroid Dread if you missed it when it originally launched in 2021. It’s getting a sequel in January called Metroid Ravenous, so you have plenty of time to catch up on Samus Aran’s previous adventures.

That includes digital games for Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch.

articles.title: Neuralink Participant Showcases What It's Like to Play GTA 6 With His Mind
articles.summary: A Neuralink participant has shared a video showcasing how the technology has allowed him to drive boats, fly planes, and get in shootouts in GTA 6 with his mind. Neuralink shared a video of one of its few participants playing Rockstar Games' latest on social media yesterday.
body: "Before the old chip and surgery, I was using a mouth stick and an iPad," he explained. "I was essentially like a bird, just pecking at an iPad. There was a few games I could play, but obviously, it made your jaw sore and everything sore.
"So then, I get a chip, and it's like, 'What does this let me do?' Immediately, controlling a computer is like, 'boom.' Portal to the world. You just immediately get your portal to the world back."

Rockstar spent 13 years painstakingly crafting the world of GTA 6 to ensure every blade of grass and every line of dialogue was given an unprecedented amount of detail. Although it's maybe truer to life than some may have hoped, there's no denying that the amount of freedom the studio gives players to do everything from robbing banks to diving for sunken treasure has attracted tens of millions of players.

Despite guiding Jason and Lucia through GTA 6 by different means, the Neuralink participant shown today is one of those millions. In a follow-up post, the tech company, which was co-founded by controversial figure and billionaire Elon Musk, reiterated that the participant and others like him are part of an extremely limited clinical trial.

articles.title: All Cheat Codes in GTA 6
articles.summary: The best part about any Grand Theft Auto game is the cheats, and Grand Theft Auto 6 delivers on that front. Rockstar's latest includes a whole mess of password-protected secrets that will really let you have some fun in Vice City. You'll have to work for them, though.
body: Here's everything you need to know about cheats in GTA 6, from how to unlock them, to the list itself.
Update (Nov. 21): We've updated this guide with inputs for three cheat codes.

If you're looking for a way to enter cheat codes the moment you start GTA 6, you're going to be disappointed. You won't be able to use them until you have fully cleared the story. Once you finish the game and return to your save file, you'll find a new Cheat tab. Open your Map, tab over to Progression, and scroll to the end to find the Cheats menu.

You won't get the actual cheat codes immediately. Each one is locked behind a requirement. That can be as simple as finding a specific car to earn the ability to summon it, or as demanding as having Jason and Lucia hold hands for four hours. Once you clear a condition, a pop-up message will tell you that you've unlocked a new Cheat code, and the unlock requirement in the Cheats menu will be replaced with the code.
points: The best part about any Grand Theft Auto game is the cheats, and Grand Theft Auto 6 delivers on that front.
Rockstar's latest includes a whole mess of password-protected secrets that will really let you have some fun in Vice City.

articles.title: Blade Director Says He Walked Away From Marvel's Canceled Movie Because 'Life's Too Short to Make S**t Films'
articles.summary: Director Bassam Tariq has opened up about why he exited Marvel's Blade movie, saying, "life's too short to make s**t films." The Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother filmmaker explained his reasoning for walking away from the Mahershala Ali superhero period piece during an interview with The New…
body: "It was funny and strange to start casting and building without a proper script," Tariq said when asked what working in the studio system taught him. "You're sitting there and explaining to actors what their role will be, and they just have to believe you.

"That's also very dangerous because if the text comes and it doesn't add up to what you were saying, your credibility gets completely shot. All I have is my integrity, and I've been thinking about that a lot."

Marvel Studios announced an Ali-led Blade film in 2019 and picked Tariq to lead the charge in 2021. A little more than one year later, and the director was said to have bounced off the project, with Marvel telling The Hollywood Reporter that "shifts in our production schedule" were to blame.

articles.title: Declasse Vamos code location in GTA 6
articles.summary: The Declasse Vamos is a car that you can steal for Moses in Grand Theft Auto 6. However, when you find the Declasse Vamos, you realize that it's locked away inside a garage, and you need to find the door code to get to it.
body: Luckily, the code can be found nearby, but it's not as clear as some of the other safe codes in GTA 6. You won't find any notes that explicitly tell you what the code is, but if you pay close attention to your surroundings, you'll find a common number that just so happens to be the code.
Here's what the Declasse Vamos code is in GTA 6, and how to find it.

Before you can steal the Declasse Vamos for Moses, you need to first steal the initial three cars that he asks you to look out for. Then, Moses will eventually hit you up with more vehicles to steal, which will include the souped-up Declasse Vamos. The Declasse Vamos is the car that's located at the eastern edge of Grayson, in Lummox County.

The Declasse Vamos you need to steal for Moses is locked in the standalone garage beside the house. On the west side of the garage, you'll find a door and a keypad that you need a four-digit code for.

articles.title: It’s Official, GTA 6’s Graphics Have Broken My Brain
articles.summary: The first time I played Grand Theft Auto 5, I was ready to wreak havoc the second I picked up the controller. When my buddy handed me the controller to try it out at his apartment, I asked him how to unlock all weapons and got up to the old tricks of my PS2 glory days.
body: The first time I played Grand Theft Auto 6 was a very different experience. Immediately taken aback by its comparatively ultrarealistic visuals, all of my usual GTA instincts went haywire. For the first time ever in one of these games, I found myself instinctively following traffic laws. I didn’t consider running a red light. I was patiently waiting in traffic jams. I wouldn’t even dare to bump another car and risk scratching up my paint. Killing a pedestrian? Absolutely not!

I’m not the only one who has experienced this phenomenon, as I’ve since discovered. PC Gamer’s Lincoln Carpenter recalled having the exact same experience in GTA 6. I’ve heard some of my colleagues say the same thing upon starting the game themselves. [ Ed. note: Confirmed.] It’s undeniable that GTA 6 ’s shift towards realistic visuals comes with some psychological side effects. In my review, I argued that the shift in mentality ends up being to GTA 6 ’s benefit as it plays into the rule-breaking joys of the series. But it does beg a tired question that feels older than GTA itself at this point: How real is too real?

When my buddy handed me the controller to try it out at his apartment, I asked him how to unlock all weapons and got up to the old tricks of my PS2 glory days.

articles.title: Phasmophobia's next update lets you ask ghosts to throw things and it's out next week
articles.summary: Phasmophobia 's next update, Resonance, arrives on 24th November, bringing a brand-new piece of ghost-hunting kit, more voice commands, and a move to the Unity 6 engine.
body: The headline addition is dowsing rods, which will help you track down the bone, making them particularly handy on bigger maps like Brownstone High School. As with the rest of the game's equipment, the higher the Tier, the more accurate the reading, and Tier 3 Dowsing Rods will pinpoint the exact floor the Bone is on.

The Sound Sensor is getting an overhaul too, with a reworked interface to help you work out where sounds are coming from. Icons will show whether a sound is ongoing or a one-off, and you'll be able to use the map to identify ghosts by how fast they move.

You'll also be able to ask ghosts to interact with doors and switches, and even throw nearby objects, with a list of usable phrases in the Journal. If you're tired of the same maps, you'll be able to build your own pool of maps to randomise from when picking a contract, and new buttons let you quickly pick small, medium, or large maps.
"We want to ensure every item in our Ghost Hunters' kits can add as much value as possible in investigations," said Daniel Knight, CEO and game director at Kinetic Games.

articles.title: Should you proceed or postpone when you meet Abe in the Protective Custody mission in GTA 6?
articles.summary: Deciding whether to proceed or postpone the Protective Custody story mission is a big choice you'll need to make in GTA 6. The mission appears on your map as "Meet Abe" in Chapter 5, once you've completed the mission Operation Savage Glory.
body: Once you get to Abe's office, Jason will warn Lucia that everything will change after this mission. Lucia will hesitate at the door as you make your choice to "Proceed" or "Postpone."

This is a pretty big decision, because Protective Custody kicks off the final mission of the game which takes about an hour to play. And even though it's a binary choice between "Proceed" (which starts the mission) and "Postpone" (which delays the mission)" there's actually a third possible outcome based on when you make the choice.

It's a long mission that will take about an hour to play, so be prepared. You can't save during this mission so make sure you've got the time! Once you've completed the final mission, you can watch the credits and return to the open world so you can continue playing.
You will go back to the open world to continue playing. The "Meet Abe" icon will remain on your map so you can begin the final mission at any point from then on.

articles.title: GTA 6 is crashing on some PS5s with error CE-108255-1 - here's what you can try
articles.summary: Some Grand Theft Auto 6 players on PS5 say the game keeps crashing with error code CE-108255-1, and in some cases, it's stopping them from progressing through the story.
body: "The game runs perfectly fine for a while. I can complete missions and chapters without any issues, but then it suddenly crashes after around 40 minutes and sends me back to the PS5 home screen", wrote one Reddit user. They added that other games, including GTA 5 and For Honor, run without crashing.

Another player told Dexerto that GTA 6 worked fine until Pipework, an early mission that introduces Mandy, but now crashes "every time I use the plunger or stand around the sink with it", which means they can’t progress.
Some PS5 Pro owners say the game crashes during the opening prologue, either at the same point every time or a few seconds in, and they haven't been able to play since launch.

Others say they've tried the usual fixes, such as clearing their console's cache, rebuilding the database, factory resetting their PS5, and even downloading the game three times, but nothing has worked thus far.

articles.title: Unannounced Nioh 3 Complete Edition has been rated in Korea
articles.summary: A rating for the unannounced Nioh 3 Complete Edition has popped up on Korea's Game Rating and Administration Committee ( GRAC ).
body: As Insider Gaming spotted, the board gave Nioh 3 Complete Edition a 19+ rating on 17th November after it was submitted on 2nd November, even though Koei Tecmo hasn't announced a Complete Edition for the game yet.

The listing, translated by machine, describes it as "a compilation of additional content from the dark Sengoku action RPG Nioh 3", and gives the rating for "excessive expression of violence", noting that "red blood and body amputation frequently occur during combat".
The listing also notes an overseas rating, which Insider Gaming says is a 17+ rating from Japan's CERO.
Unlike some rating boards, GRAC publishes its ratings as soon as they're decided, which is why game listings often surface there before they're officially announced.

articles.title: Skyrim lead chats about the Fallout diehards who hated that Bethesda got the series: 'We had to prove them wrong, and fortunately we did'
articles.summary: When Bethesda got its hands on the Fallout licence way back in 2004, the naysayers were many and vocal. In fairness, the naysayers are still many and vocal, but they were back then too, and it turns out Bethesda saw at least a few of their posts.
body: "There was huge pushback when Bethesda got the Fallout licence to do Fallout 3. There was a lot of people who were Obsidian fans, who were like 'Bethesda's gonna screw it up, they're just gonna make it Skyrim, we want Fallout the way we remember Fallout', and there was a strong, vocal community that just hated that we were gonna make that game".

For clarity's sake, the angry fans at the time were likely Black Isle and Interplay fans rather than Obsidian fans—the latter studio hadn't ever made a Fallout game in 2004 (though it had Fallout alumni on staff), and they were prophesying (after 2006) that Bethesda's take on Fallout would be like Oblivion, not Skyrim, since the latter released in 2011. I suspect Nesmith is muddling the initial negative reaction with, well, the more modern one, which is shaped in large part by Obsidian's excellent Fallout: New Vegas from 2010.

articles.title: GTA 6 features the series' first non-binary character, says actor Jesse James Rose, and players can't hurt them
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 features the first non-binary character in the series' history, according to actor Jesse James Rose, who plays the role of a museum curator in the game.
body: "I can FINALLY share that I play the first-ever nonbinary character in the Grand Theft Auto franchise!" Rose wrote on Instagram.
"Absolutely wild to find out THIS was the super-secret game I spent weeks and 17 NDAs filming 3 years ago."

"I shot this back in my they/them days, and everyone on production ensured I was comfortable and gendered correctly," Rose wrote. The project was kept so secret that Rose wasn't told what it was during filming and only recently learned it was GTA 6.
"GTA was one of the most inclusive & caring sets I've ever been on," they added.

articles.title: How to steal the BF Bandito in GTA 6
articles.summary: The BF Bandito is one of the many cars in GTA 6 that Moses asks you to steal and bring to him for cold, hard cash. This one has a search area out in Buskin Swamp, but when you arrive it's not immediately clear where or how to steal the car.
body: The owner of this white offroad racer will drive around the map marked search area in a circle, as shown in the clip above. To get him to stop, simply park your car blocking the track and stand next to it. When he reaches you, he'll slow down and call out, at which point you should press L2 to focus on him and use the "Mislead" dialogue option to ask for help.

In my version, Lucia was wearing a ski-mask and had a baseball bat, which quickly convinced them all to run away (after a few swings), but either way, once he stops it's easy to steal the car. The baseball bat probably wasn't necessary, but hey, it's still non-lethal.

As you exit the swamp, you'll get shot at and pursued by a few of his friends, but the BF Bandito is fast enough to outrun them easily. Bring it back to Moses to get $3,400ish as reward, though this may vary based on condition.
